description: This cottage and rustic themed 100% cotton weave checkered fabric tablecloth was designed to be a favorite for your indoor or outdoor entertaining. The Farm Check Gingham fabric tablecloths feature a large scale buffalo check in classic colors with a subtle checkered visual texture. Farm or Buffalo checks are suitable for many styles of decor including cabin, lodge, cottage, country, contemporary, traditional and modern. Great for use with adults and children at home or in commercial settings. Perfect for decorating for Mothers Day, Memorial Day, Fathers Day, Fourth Of July, Labor Day, barbecues, beach dining and summer entertaining and everyday use. 100% cotton construction is easy care and requires little ironing. Machine washable and either line dry or tumble dry at lowest setting. Finished with sewn edges. Easy to fold and store when not in use. Buffalo Check tablecloths are available in selection of 7 sizes and matching fabric napkins. Sizes available are: 52 Inch x 70 Inch Oblong/Rectangle, 60 Inch x 84 Inch Oblong/Rectangle, 60 Inch x 102 Inch Oblong/Rectangle and 70 Inch Round. Matching Napkins are sold in sets of 4 units. 5 new Gingham Farm Check colors: Black, Cornflower Blue, Red, Camel and Grey
